note: The main banks were taken as Bosnia and Herzegovina's three largest by assets, a choice from general knowledge (no central bank or association ranking was read in this pass): UniCredit Bank, Raiffeisen Bank BiH and Intesa Sanpaolo Banka BiH, with Sparkasse Bank BiH kept from the earlier reading. Sparkasse Bank BiH: its standard information sheet for its MasterCard revolving card (published July 2025), read again 2026-10-30. It bears a fixed 13.99% a year and costs 3.50 marks a month and 20 marks to process the application to issue it (none within its SPAR packages, which the game doesn't hold). The monthly minimum is 4% of the principal owed plus all the fees and interest due. A cash withdrawal at the bank's own ATM or POS costs 1.50% plus 10 marks (others' not written). In the Federation, overdue sums bear the statutory default rate, stated as 10.00% a year on the sheet's date; it is set by law, lower than the card's rate and varies, so it isn't written as a penalty. UniCredit's, Raiffeisen's and Intesa's card terms weren't reached in this pass and aren't written.

sources.said: MasterCard revolving: 4% dugovane glavnice (potrošeni limiti) uvećane za 100% dugovane naknade ... Visina nominalne kamatne stope: 13,99% ... Osnovne kreditne kartice - mjesečna članarina 3.50 KM ... Osnovne kreditne kartice - naknada za obradu zahtjeva za izdavanje i 20 KM ... Podizanje gotovine na POS terminalu ili ATM-u Banke 1,50% + 10,00 KM ... obračunava po stopi od 10,00% godišnje.
